name: Range breakout with momentum confirmation (15m)
rationale: A break to the top of the 15m Donchian range confirmed by a positive short return filters the false breakouts that plague naive channel systems: the momentum leg proves real order flow, not a single-print wick. The other side is the range-fader who sells the highs and is forced to cover as the breakout extends. Edge persists because breakouts from consolidations attract trend-followers who add liquidity demand in one direction. Disconfirmer: exits when price falls back inside the range (range_position drops below the exit level), signalling a failed breakout, before the stop.
catalyst: range high break confirmed by positive momentum
